title: Total plays
statementMd:
How many plays are recorded in total?

Expected columns: `plays`.

Tables: `artists`, `albums`, `tracks`, `listeners`, `plays`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT COUNT(*) AS plays FROM plays;
```
